verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships an official MCP server. Its docs say any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can connect, letting users "ask an assistant to look things up and take actions on your behalf" and "query or update" controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks. That is first-party natural-language operation of the product, with OAuth sign-in and an API-key mode for setups with no browser. Missing for 10: no native in-app natural-language command interface (Comply AI features are generation helpers, not command surfaces), thin detail on which write actions are exposed, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
